Down 5% incl. and excl. net DVA(F) – Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) revenue down 17% to $2.6 billion. $2.5 billion excl. net DVA(F) – Equities revenue up 11% to $2.5 billion. Excl. net DVA, up 10%(F) From Chair and CEO Brian Moynihan: The team delivered organic growth, deepening client relationships and adding new ones. While investment banking and sales and trading revenues were lower, commercial lending grew in every client segment. Our momentum, reflected in growth in client deposits, wealth flows and consumer activity, supported solid earnings, balance-sheet growth and long-term shareholder value. Moynihan added: Our disciplined investments in AI are helping teammates serve clients better, work faster and manage risk more effectively. With more than 200,000 teammates using AI tools and 300-plus approved use cases across the company, we are turning our scale into a competitive advantage. Organic growth helped drive higher revenue and solid earnings. Net interest income grew 8% from last year, supported by continued year-over-year and sequential improvement in net interest yield, while asset management fees rose 17%. Asset quality continued to improve and liquidity and capital remained strong. reference.summary: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services.
